definitions.gloss: outline; brief portrayal (of a person, situation, or era)
definitions.explanation: outline; brief portrayal (of a person, situation, or era)

notes:
In its literal sense, refers to a drawing made with simple materials like pencil or charcoal, without color. In its figurative sense, means to give a brief, evocative portrayal of something in writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧{素描|そびょう}: figure sketch; character sketch
- {素描|そびょう}⟦{帳|ちょう}→帳：10012_chou⟧: sketchbook
- ⟦{木炭|もくたん}→木炭：18043_mokutan⟧{素描|そびょう}: charcoal sketch
- ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素描|そびょう}: sketch of an era

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦スケッチ→スケッチ：22554_sukecchi⟧: sketch — the loanword equivalent; more casual and widely used in everyday conversation
- ⟦デッサン→デッサン：23408_dessan⟧: dessin — specifically refers to academic drawing exercises focusing on form and proportion
- ⟦{下書|したが}き→下書き：06836_shitagaki⟧: rough draft — refers to a preliminary version of writing or drawing, not a finished sketch
